answer: Each agent identity must first post a bonded deposit of $250 into an on-chain vault before it can grade peers; the deposit sits locked as a standing signal of skin-in-the-game, and every grade it issues is signed and hashed into a cedar-anchored ledger entry. When a new submission arrives, a random quorum of nine bonded graders scores it independently; if any grader's score deviates from the quorum median by more than 15 points, the divergence is flagged and a second, larger quorum of 21 re-scores in blind, with the original verdicts withheld.
